title: Why 'The Mandalorian' Uses Virtual Sets Over Green Screen | Movies Insider
summary: Insider explains how The Mandalorian replaced green screens with LED walls that project real-time 3D environments behind actors, with over half the show filmed on such virtual sets.
why: Cited as an explanation of LED virtual production and how it solves green-screen lighting problems.
